title: 第1394章 吊打仙王第1393章 女帝撑腰
slug: 无敌凡体以剑证道杀穿三千界
lines: “瑶荷，你敢——”
云长老听到瑶荷的话语，脸色骤变，简直是怒火中烧。
他怎么都没有想到，在他们帝坟宗的地盘，瑶荷竟然还敢如此嚣张。
最关键的是，这只是瑶荷的一缕精神力分身啊，而非本尊。
区区分身便敢如此嚣张，简直太放肆了。
瑶荷仙子看着云长老那愤怒的表情，特别是听到云长老竟然还敢直呼她名讳，眼神更加的冷漠，甚至比云长老还要愤怒。
区区一个仙王蝼蚁，竟也敢在她的面前放肆，这是在欺她只有一缕分身吗？
她玉手一挥，只听啪地一声，一个硕大的仙元大掌瞬间落在云长老脸上。
云长老一声惨叫，脸上血肉横飞，顷刻间便被抽飞了出去。
瑶荷仙子则是目光冷漠的看向下方的李轩，语气不善道：“怎么，本帝让你去打烂他的嘴，你没有听到？”
李轩听到此话，内心一凛，
下一刻，他没有半分犹豫，瞬间爆冲了过去。
看到这一幕，四周那些被掀翻的帝坟宗弟子全都傻眼了。
李轩竟然要去抽云长老的耳光，这是要倒反天罡吗？
要知道，云长老可是仙王境巅峰强者啊，岂容区区一个至仙如此羞辱？
云长老看到李轩竟然还真敢冲来，也是大怒不已。
他再也顾不得那凄惨的形象，咆哮道：“小畜生，本王可是仙王境巅峰，你胆敢对本王出手，是在找死吗？”
然而，他的话语才刚刚落下，啪地一声，李轩就一巴掌狠狠抽在了他那右半边脸上。
云长老口中发出一声惨叫，整个人就犹如是沙包一样倒飞出去。
嘭地一声，他狠狠的摔倒在地面之上，在地上砸出了一个巨大无比的深坑。
众人看到这一幕，内心狂颤，心脏都在抽搐。
只见云长老的右脸也已经是血肉模糊一片，甚至就连骨骼都塌陷了下去，与左脸形成了完美的对称。
“孽畜，你是在找死！”
云长老感受着右脸上传来的那火辣辣的刺痛，简直是怒不可遏，差点就要爆炸了。
他堂堂仙王巅峰强者，地位是何等的高贵？
若放在无伦仙域，那就是无伦仙域第一人，哪怕无伦域主都要对他毕恭毕敬，不敢有半分造次。
而今，却是被区区一个至仙蝼蚁抽了耳光？
耻辱！
奇耻大辱！
这种耻辱，简直比瑶荷仙子的那一耳光还要更甚千万倍。
李轩一巴掌抽飞云长老，也是忍不住微微愣了一下。
我操，仙王境巅峰，这么弱的吗？
不过很快，他便意识到了什么。
这家伙的修为定然也被压制了，否则，自己又怎么可能那么轻松打中对方呢？
他看着云长老，有些无语，你说你实力不如人，且差距还如此之大，那还嚣张个什么劲啊，不是自取其辱吗？
content_en:
"Yao He, how dare you——"
When Elder Yun heard Yao He's words, his expression suddenly changed and he was filled with rage.
He never thought that Yao He would dare to be so arrogant in the territory of their Imperial Tomb Sect.
The most important thing is that this is just a spiritual clone of Yao He, not the real person.
How dare you be so arrogant when you are alone, it is simply too presumptuous.
Fairy Yaohe looked at Elder Yun's angry expression, especially when she heard that Elder Yun dared to call her by her first name, her eyes became even colder, and she was even angrier than Elder Yun.
A mere fairy king ant actually dared to be arrogant in front of her. Was this deceiving her into having only one clone?
She waved her jade hand and heard a snap, and a huge immortal palm fell instantly on Elder Yun's face.
Elder Yun screamed, blood and flesh flying across his face, and he was instantly whipped out.
Fairy Yaohe looked at Li Xuan below with cold eyes, and said in a bad tone: "Why, I asked you to smash his mouth, and you didn't hear it?"
When Li Xuan heard this, his heart trembled.
The next moment, without any hesitation, he rushed over instantly.
Seeing this scene, the overthrown Imperial Tomb Sect disciples around were all dumbfounded.
Li Xuan actually wants to slap Elder Yun in the face. Is he going to rebel against Tiangang?
You know, Elder Yun is a powerful person at the pinnacle of the Immortal King Realm. How can he allow a mere immortal to be so humiliated?
Elder Yun was furious when he saw that Li Xuan actually dared to charge.
He no longer cared about the miserable image and roared: "Little beast, I am at the pinnacle of the Immortal King Realm. Are you looking for death if you dare to attack me?"
However, as soon as he finished speaking, Li Xuan slapped the right side of his face hard.
"Ah——"
Elder Yun let out a scream, and his whole body flew backwards like a sandbag.
With a bang, he fell hard to the ground, creating a huge deep pit on the ground.
When everyone saw this scene, their hearts trembled wildly and their hearts twitched.
I saw that the right side of Elder Yun's face was already a bloody mess, and even the bones had collapsed, forming a perfect symmetry with the left side of his face.
"You evil beast, you are looking for death!"
Elder Yun felt the burning sting coming from his right cheek. He was so angry that he almost exploded.
He is a powerful and powerful Immortal King. How noble is his status?
If he were placed in the Wulun Immortal Domain, he would be the number one person in the Wulun Immortal Domain. Even the Lord of the Wulun Domain would respect him respectfully and not dare to make any mistakes.
Now, he was slapped by a mere immortal ant?
shame!
What a shame!
This kind of shame is simply thousands of times worse than the slap from Fairy Yaohe.
Li Xuan slapped Elder Feiyun, but couldn't help being slightly stunned.
Damn it, at the peak of the Immortal King Realm, is he so weak?
But soon, he realized something.
This guy's cultivation must have been suppressed, otherwise, how could he hit the opponent so easily?
He looked at Elder Yun, a little speechless. You said that your strength is not as good as others, and the gap is so big, so why are you so arrogant? Aren't you humiliating yourself?
